environment: Hermes Native headless Rust regression suite at the source commit; full locked workspace suite and all-target locked cargo check completed by the implementation owner.
notes: Headless UI regressions cover the unresolved-owner fallback, read-only mutation guard without a live writer, and the rule that ordinary live-resume errors do not trigger fallback. Gateway regressions cover profile-roster parsing and transport, ID-only stored-transcript requests, response bounds, endpoint/connection fencing, and local-ticket/remote-auth behavior. Historical transcript recovery remains read-only unless the user explicitly selects a matching live profile and resume succeeds. Explicit profile metadata carried in a stored transcript is display data, not routing authority. Limitation: transcript is first 120 messages only; no older-page UI. Authenticated live Gateway, packaged Windows interaction, and formal pinned-source acceptance remain open.
